reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes paying to activate progressively more expensive Forsage positions while presenting the resulting income and profits as increasing and encouraging viewers to build a team. It gives a concrete participation strategy involving multiple positions, a stated ETH cost and gas funding, then directs viewers to continue with the person who shared the video. The communication is an earning solicitation centered on a tiered team structure rather than a warning or investigation.

your optional team strategy to Strategy to get started Open 6 positions

Total cost 0.35 ETH To be safe, load 0.38 ETH to cover the gas on the blockchain
This is a fanastic earning platform where you can earn daily and instantly to your crypto wallet.

opening.argument: Judge the wording actually used: the presenter says, "You may activate as many levels as you wish. The choice is yours," and calls the proposed starting approach an "optional team strategy." The stated funding amount also accounts for a cost beyond the listed positions: "To be safe, load 0.38 ETH to cover the gas on the blockchain." This is a description of a selectable approach and its transaction cost, not a claim that every viewer must participate or that a particular return is guaranteed. That distinction matters when deciding whether the video is a deceptive solicitation.

citations.quote: You may activate as many levels as you wish. The choice is yours
your optional team strategy
To be safe, load 0.38 ETH to cover the gas on the blockchain

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution is right that the presenter discusses increasing income and a team approach. But its own quoted language calls the approach "optional," while the fuller explanation says the number of levels is the viewer's choice. A stated ETH cost and gas allowance disclose what the proposed setup requires; they do not, by themselves, establish a guaranteed payout or concealment of the cost.

citations.quote: your optional team strategy
You may activate as many levels as you wish. The choice is yours
Total cost 0.35 ETH To be safe, load 0.38 ETH to cover the gas on the blockchain

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Optional participation is not a risk warning. The presenter tells viewers to "Make your payment, thus activating that level," asserts that "the income and profits are twice as high," and recommends a strategy that will help grow a team faster when everyone follows it. Disclosing gas costs does not change the pitch's central connection between paid positions, claimed earnings, and team growth.

opening.argument: The presentation begins by orienting the viewer to an interface: "This is what your back office on the Forsage platform would look like." It then explains that "Both the x3 and x4 have 12 levels" and describes clicking a shopping cart to activate a level. The sampled diagram shows two labeled sets of levels rather than evidence of anyone receiving a payout. Read the discussion of positions and costs as an operational walkthrough of what the interface asks a user to do. Explaining a platform's workflow, even one involving payment, is not itself proof that the presenter has demonstrated a working income opportunity.

citations.quote: This is what your back office on the Forsage platform would look like.
Both the x3 and x4 have 12 levels. When you activate the level you will click on the shopping cart.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution treats the six-position example and ETH figure as decisive solicitation. In the surrounding explanation, though, the presenter first identifies the back-office view and explains how levels are activated. The diagram and cost can therefore be read as parts of a walkthrough. Neither the quoted cost nor the diagram documents an actual payout or shows where any resulting income originates.

citations.quote: This is what your back office on the Forsage platform would look like.
Total cost 0.35 ETH To be safe, load 0.38 ETH to cover the gas on the blockchain

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The interface explanation is embedded in a pitch, not a neutral demonstration. The description calls it an earning platform, the narration claims higher income and profits at higher-cost levels, and the presenter recommends a team strategy before directing viewers back to the person who shared the video. A diagram need not show a completed payout for those instructions and earnings claims to function as promotion.

citations.quote: This is a fanastic earning platform where you can earn daily and instantly to your crypto wallet.
Each level is two times the cost of the previous level. As a result, the income and profits are twice as high.
This is my most popular strategy and it will help you grow your team faster when everyone in your team follows the same strategy now please get back to the person who shared this video with you

opening.argument: The demonstrated transaction is a purchase-like action: the viewer clicks a shopping cart, makes a payment, and activates a level. The presenter also discusses an optional strategy for growing a team. Those facts could describe a paid platform with a referral promotion; they do not establish, on their own, that a viewer is paid specifically for recruiting others, that rewards come from later participants' payments, or that anyone must recruit to receive income. The description's earnings language warrants scrutiny, but the supplied explanation leaves those decisive mechanics unshown. Do not infer a recruitment-commission scheme solely from the presence of positions and team advice.

citations.quote: When you activate the level you will click on the shopping cart. Make your payment, thus activating that level.
This is my most popular strategy and it will help you grow your team faster when everyone in your team follows the same strategy
This is a fanastic earning platform where you can earn daily and instantly to your crypto wallet.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution connects paid positions, claimed earnings, and team growth, but the cited sentences do not say who pays the income or specify a commission for each recruit. The recommendation that everyone in a team follow the same strategy can also be read as shared setup advice. Those omissions matter before treating an observed payment-and-referral discussion as proof of a particular payout mechanism.

citations.quote: Each level is two times the cost of the previous level. As a result, the income and profits are twice as high.
This is my most popular strategy and it will help you grow your team faster when everyone in your team follows the same strategy

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The video does not need to trace every transfer to show what it promotes. It instructs viewers to pay to activate positions, claims higher income and profits as level costs rise, then offers a multi-position strategy expressly intended to grow the participant's team faster. Calling the payment a shopping-cart transaction does not supply an ordinary product or separate source of earnings.
